snippet.title: Castle of Alchemists - Official Announcement Trailer | PlayStation®️5 / Nintendo Switch™️ | GSE
snippet.description:
Developed by Team Machiavelli and published globally by GSE, the hardcore Action Tower Defence game "Castle of Alchemists" is officially coming to PlayStation®️5 and Nintendo Switch™️!

Join us during the Steam Tower Defense Fest from March 9 to 16! Experience a visceral fusion of tactical tower defense and high-octane combat. Take control of Bellator, a cybernetically enhanced alchemist, and unleash an arsenal of melee weapons, firearms, and traps to repel the mechanical horde in stunningly detailed 2D pixel art.

【Product Information】
Title: Castle of Alchemists
Platform: PlayStation®️5/ Nintendo Switch™️
Developer: Team Machiavelli
Publisher:  Game Source Entertainment
